part.text:
Done. Summary of changes:

- `next.config.ts`: enabled `cacheComponents: true`
- `lib/products.ts`: `getProduct` now marked `'use cache'`, so product details (per slug + currency) are reused across requests
- `app/products/[slug]/page.tsx`: static shop frame (nav, collection label, headings) renders instantly; product details (including `currency` searchParam) stream inside a `Suspense` boundary so each URL/currency shows correct data; related products stream in afterward via their own `Suspense`

Production build passes with no route opt-outs — `/products/[slug]` is now Partial Prerender (◐), and verified: `/products/lamp?currency=EUR` → "EUR 110.40", `/products/vase` → "USD 80.00".
